prompts.background: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: final portrait background texture for a polished fantasy strategy card game's deck preparation screen, inspired by League of Legends rune-world art and premium Clash Royale material readability. Create a single background image, NOT a UI mockup. Portrait 2:3. An ancient blue-black stone and aged bronze rune archive, viewed straight on, finely hand-painted game art, tactile worn slate with subtle mineral flecks, restrained antique-gold engraved arcs along the extreme outer edges, a faint large circular runic relief near the upper third. Top middle softly illuminated by cool magical light, lower area quiet dark navy teal. At least 85% of the image is quiet dark low-contrast texture, to place colorful cards and readable text on top later. No characters, no cards, no buttons, no text, no letters, no logos. Rich believable material variation and soft painterly depth, not flat vector, not noisy, no bright light sources. Palette #09151e #152c35 #263b40 restrained gold #b99b61. Edge ornaments subtle and elegant, center very uncluttered. This is a production game texture covering the entire screen.
prompts.panel: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production square nine-slice UI panel texture for a premium fantasy card game. 1:1 square, perfectly straight-on orthographic. The panel occupies the entire image edge-to-edge. A finely beveled aged bronze metal rim takes up only the outermost 5 percent on all four sides, with tiny elegant chiseled diagonal corner joints. Inside is continuous dark blue-black slate with extremely subtle hand-painted mineral grain and brushed wear, mild recessed shading near the edges. The broad middle 80 percent must be quiet and uniform enough to stretch horizontally or vertically behind text and cards. Physically tactile, painterly League of Legends-style fantasy interface material, restrained polished metal glints, warm desaturated gold #bda570 rim, deep teal slate #132830 field. No lettering, no symbols in center, no icons, no screws, no gems, no UI layout, no large ornaments. No perspective. Opaque background. High quality surface texture and convincing beveled edge rather than flat colored rectangles. Designed for splitting at 8 percent from each edge to render scalable buttons and framed panels.
prompts.rune: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one small readable production game UI icon on transparent background. Redesign a generic active-card rune emblem drawing on League of Legends world-rune / runes-reforged visual concepts: a sculptural ancient carved keystone of dark indigo blue mineral, three elegant separated stone facets surrounding one luminous abstract arcane glyph. The glyph is a flowing angular interlocking curve with a hollow center, absolutely no Latin letters, no R, no lightning bolt, no shield silhouette, no snowflake. Strong beautiful simple silhouette, polished hand-painted AAA fantasy game inventory icon, thick readable shapes at 32px. Restrained glowing pale gold and icy lavender in the carving, an incomplete aged gold arc around the lower stone, subtle blue light within cracks. Almost circular composition, centered, single object fills 85% of canvas. Sophisticated and magical, tactile stone and metal, not a flat vector icon, not overly detailed or spiky. No background, no ground, no text, no multiple icons, no UI screen. Genuine alpha transparency.
